name: p1-living-room-shadcn-us-portrait
description: Living room (shadcn) on us-portrait, compiled from projects/living-room-shadcn/project.json by scripts/build-project-hmi.mjs. 16 screens, 106 placements becoming 637 Nextion components, in the theme "shadcn-dark". The base is the minimal eseverson project: one empty page, no fonts, and the same Modelcrc as joBr99's file, which is the NX4832F035_011C this panel is. Pages draw and navigate on their own; the serial protocol to berry/ is not in this step.
program:
int sys0=0,sys1=0,sys2=0
bauds=115200
dim=100
recmod=0
printh 00 00 00 ff ff ff 88 ff ff ff
page 0
